scripts.dev: npm run build -w web && node scripts/assemble-assets.mjs && concurrently -k "wrangler dev" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && node scripts/assemble-assets.mjs && node scripts/dive/check-web.mjs && node scripts/wordguess/check-web.mjs && node scripts/perception/check-web.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker && node scripts/dive/check-worker.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && node scripts/assemble-assets.mjs && wrangler deploy
